svg.title: AI Vision Pro — project 04.4
svg.desc: AI Vision Pro — Image classification web app with TensorFlow & Streamlit. Features: Image upload (JPG / PNG); MobileNetV2 inference; Top-3 predictions; Confidence visualization; ImageNet · 1000 classes. Tech: Python, TensorFlow, MobileNetV2, Streamlit, NumPy, Pillow. Repository: github.com/thedenilsonpinto/AI-Vision-Pro.
